description.narrative: (Bangladesh): USAID's Bangladesh America Maitree Activity (BAMA) is an integrated activity that is grounded in locally driven strategies to strengthen the capacity of Bangladesh's civil society partners and promote broad-based, inclusive, and sustainable development. Using FY 2024 funds, Maitree will issue small grants to Bangladeshi NGOs through its flexible grant-making facility and offer a range of capacity strengthening options to qualified local partners based on participatory organizational assessments that will direct the technical and organizational capacity strengthening support. The activity will also strengthen the capacity of the NGO/CSO network in Bangladesh for advocacy efforts on shared agendas.This activity will advance all four development objectives of the CDCS and cover all technical sectors that the Mission implements. This is the Mission's integrated initiative on localization. Funding for the activity contributes to the Global Food Security ($2,000,000).
